styles: Precision workspace

Cool white and slate, indigo accent, compact crisp sans serif, fine borders. 220px labeled left navigation and a slim top utility bar. Task-centric central editing area and narrow right review inspector.
Navy operations

Deep navy full-height left sidebar, bright white work surface, teal accent, square-edged enterprise controls. Wide horizontal status strip; two equal main work panes for objective and goals; bottom horizontal notes tray. Strong operational SaaS feel.
Horizontal studio

No left sidebar. Warm ivory background, charcoal sans serif, restrained amber accent. Top horizontal navigation with Lantern, My work, Position focus, Inbox, Department, Guide and right Account avatar. Below use an expansive split workspace: 35% objective column and 65% compact goal matrix. Thin rules, flat surfaces, no rounded card clutter.
Swiss grid

Strict black and white with a single vermilion accent, Helvetica-like typography, strong aligned grid, tiny uppercase labels, sharp corners. Compact 70px icon rail and secondary horizontal tab navigation. Dense but readable spreadsheet-like goal table dominates, with objective pinned as a band above. Functional Swiss information design, never editorial article.
Night command

Dark mode: near-black charcoal background, layered graphite panels, restrained violet and pale lilac accents, compact sans typography. Slim left icon rail plus labeled secondary project navigation, central work tabs and right notes inspector. Desktop productivity-tool precision, no neon glow or cyberpunk.
Blue clarity

Pale sky blue canvas, cobalt accents, large readable humanist sans typography, friendly rounded controls, clean ample workspace. Compact floating left navigation rail with labels, broad central objective editor, bottom three goal panels, integrated right help drawer with simple line diagrams. Calm approachable SaaS, not a marketing landing page.
Warm workbench

Sand and ivory surfaces, olive active states, muted terracotta accents, practical sans serif, subtle ruled dividers. Compact top app bar and a permanent left outline of this focus (Objective, Goals, Gaps, Development), while global navigation is horizontal at top. Main workspace looks like structured professional planning software, compact rows, not a notebook illustration or prose reader.
Modular board

White canvas with bold cobalt and selective golden yellow, geometric sans, medium-radius bordered modules, chunky but professional visual hierarchy. Wide labeled left nav and horizontal work stages Draft / Discuss / Agreed. Central objective strip above three compact goal columns, compact notes lane to right. A practical planning board with purposeful mini diagrams, no analytics.
Graphite navigator

Graphite narrow global navigation rail, soft grey secondary list pane, mint accent on white main detail pane. True three-pane master-detail layout: global icons, focus outline/list, selected work item. Compact system typography, subtle dividers, desktop mail-client-like efficiency. Selected objective with goals in detail, horizontal notes composer below.
Plum focus

White and soft lavender, deep plum text and plum primary buttons, modern geometric sans. No sidebar: compact top product navigation, horizontal segmented work tabs beneath title, a wide centered two-column task canvas and persistent bottom action bar. Step-oriented but non-linear professional workspace, small fine-line explanatory diagrams, restrained and clean.
